pages.title: Tidal Physics
pages.text: $(thing)Tidal Physics$()$(br2)Gravity pulls harder on your near side than your far side. Near a small black hole the difference tears anything apart lengthwise - spaghettification.

$(thing)Insight$(): 220$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Inside a Black Hole, Frame Dragging.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 4 Tidal Shear Crystal, 1 Micro Singularity.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): A body of length L hangs head-down at distance r from a mass M. Write the difference a between the pull on its two ends, with G.
